mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news n JOIN news_stocks ns ON ns.news_id = n.id WHERE ns.symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO news (vendor_id, headline, summary, url, source, published_at) VALUES (#{vendorId}, #{headline}, #{summary}, #{url}, #{source}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM ( SELECT symbol FROM holdings WHERE quantity > 0 UNION SELECT symbol FROM watchlists ) s ORDER BY symbol
